authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural and physical inconsistencies typical of AI generation. The croissants appear to float or rest impossibly on the smooth metal roof of the truck without casting realistic contact shadows or showing weight deformation; they look pasted onto the surface. The texture of the croissants is uniform and airbrushed, lacking natural baked dough gradients. Additionally, the clock face lacks appropriate foreshortening distortion given the viewing angle, appearing perfectly flat against a perspective view. While the truck and clock themselves are rendered with reasonable detail, the interaction between objects (croissants on truck, truck vs clock depth) breaks physical realism.

Texture anomaly: Croissant surfaces appear airbrushed and unnatural.
